title: Sweet & Savory Dessert Board
seo_title: Dessert Cheese Board for 8–12: Aged Gouda, Chocolate & Honeycomb
description: A sweet and savory dessert cheese board for 8–12: aged Gouda, brie, Gorgonzola dolce, mascarpone, dark chocolate, honeycomb, figs and dates.
hook: Cheese as dessert: four dessert-friendly cheeses with chocolate, honeycomb and fruit, and just enough prosciutto to keep it savory.
why: Some cheeses taste like dessert already. Aged Gouda has caramel and butterscotch notes and little crunchy crystals, Gorgonzola dolce is the sweet, mild blue, and mascarpone is basically a dessert cream. Brie in the middle takes on whatever sweet thing it touches.

Honeycomb is the centerpiece, and dark chocolate, dates and figs give the cheeses partners. A little prosciutto, salted almonds and a pinch of flaky salt stop it from being all sugar, which is what makes you keep eating.

timeline.what: Take out the brie and Gouda; break the chocolate.
Wash the fruit; halve the figs and dates.
Place the cheeses and the honeycomb.
Add the chocolate, dried fruit, crackers and prosciutto.
Finish with a pinch of flaky salt and serve.

faq.a: Aged Gouda is the easiest match because of its caramel notes. Brie, mascarpone and a sweet blue like Gorgonzola dolce also work with dark chocolate.

faq.q: Can you serve a cheese board as dessert?
faq.a: Yes. It's standard in France. Pick cheeses with sweet notes and add honeycomb, fruit and chocolate.

faq.q: What wine goes with a dessert cheese board?
faq.a: Port, late-harvest white or a sweet sparkling wine like Moscato d'Asti.
